snippet.title: Bound To Fail - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Bound To Fail now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4508090/Bound_To_Fail/

Coming to Steam April 23!

You are bound to a chair. Jump and roll to overcome obstacles as you climb your way to freedom. It will be difficult. Go alone, or bring friends. You must escape.
